pairs: Obsecro itaque vos ego vinctus in Domino,
as a prisoner in the Lord,
I beg you to walk in a manner worthy of the vocation to which you have been called:
solliciti servare unitatem Spiritus in vinculo pacis.
Be anxious to preserve the unity of the Spirit within the bonds of peace.
sicut vocati estis in una spe vocationis vestræ.
to this you have been called by the one hope of your calling:
one God and Father of all,
Unicuique autem nostrum data est gratia secundum mensuram donationis Christi.
Yet to each one of us there has been given grace according to the measure allotted by Christ.
what is left except for him also to descend,
nisi quia et descendit primum in inferiores partes terræ?
first to the lower parts of the earth?
Qui descendit, ipse est et qui ascendit super omnes cælos,
He who descended is the same one who also ascended above all the heavens,
so that he might fulfill everything.
Et ipse dedit quosdam quidem apostolos,
And the same one granted that some would be Apostles,
ad consummationem sanctorum in opus ministerii,
for the sake of the perfection of the saints, by the work of the ministry,
in the edification of the body of Christ,
donec occurramus omnes in unitatem fidei,
until we all meet in the unity of faith
and in the knowledge of the Son of God,
in the measure of the age of the fullness of Christ.
ut jam non simus parvuli fluctuantes,
So may we then no longer be little children,
et circumferamur omni vento doctrinæ in nequitia hominum,
disturbed and carried about by every wind of doctrine, by the wickedness of men,
and by the craftiness which deceives unto error.
Instead, acting according to truth in charity,
in him who is the head, Christ himself.
ex quo totum corpus compactum et connexum per omnem juncturam subministrationis,
For in him, the whole body is joined closely together, by every underlying joint,
secundum operationem in mensuram uniuscujusque membri,
through the function allotted to each part,
augmentum corporis facit in ædificationem sui in caritate.
bringing improvement to the body, toward its edification in charity.
and I testify in the Lord:
that from now on you should walk,
sicut et gentes ambulant in vanitate sensus sui,
not as the Gentiles also walk, in the vanity of their mind,
alienati a vita Dei per ignorantiam,
being alienated from the life of God,
through the ignorance that is within them,
because of the blindness of their hearts.
have given themselves over to sexual immorality,
in operationem immunditiæ omnis in avaritiam.
carrying out every impurity with rapacity.
Vos autem non ita didicistis Christum,
But this is not what you have learned in Christ.
For certainly, you have listened to him,
and you have been instructed in him,
according to the truth that is in Jesus:
deponere vos secundum pristinam conversationem veterem hominem,
to set aside your earlier behavior, the former man,
who was corrupted, by means of desire, unto error,
and so be renewed in the spirit of your mind,
and so put on the new man, who,
qui secundum Deum creatus est in justitia, et sanctitate veritatis.
in accord with God, is created in justice and in the holiness of truth.
Because of this, setting aside lying,
loquimini veritatem unusquisque cum proximo suo:
speak the truth, each one with his neighbor.
For we are all part of one another.
but do not be willing to sin.”
sol non occidat super iracundiam vestram.
Do not let the sun set over your anger.
Provide no place for the devil.
ut habeat unde tribuat necessitatem patienti.
so that he may have something to distribute to those who suffer need.
Omnis sermo malus ex ore vestro non procedat:
Let no evil words proceed from your mouth, but only what is good,
sed si quis bonus ad ædificationem fidei ut det gratiam audientibus.
toward the edification of faith, so as to bestow grace upon those who listen.
Et nolite contristare Spiritum Sanctum Dei:
And do not be willing to grieve the Holy Spirit of God,
in quo signati estis in diem redemptionis.
in whom you have been sealed, unto the day of redemption.
Omnis amaritudo, et ira, et indignatio, et clamor, et blasphemia tollatur a vobis cum omni malitia.
Let all bitterness and anger and indignation and outcry and blasphemy be taken away from you, along with all malice.
And be kind and merciful to one another,
donantes invicem sicut et Deus in Christo donavit vobis.
just as God has forgiven you in Christ.
